race.description: Nutrien Equine Nsw Breeders Challenge Pace (G3)
race.comment: GUNNA RELOAD (2) won the three-year-old fillies final of this series last year and looks to be in form at the right time again, leading from wider when scoring by 3.2m last week. That took her strike rate at this circuit and distance to 50 per cent and she has recorded three wins and a placing from four third up attempts so should be peaking. Can go forward again from the low draw and looks tough to catch. SMIRKIN SERENE (4) dug deep for a second-up win last week, adding to a handy record at this circuit and distance. Draws wider but has won two of three previous second-up attempts so can be in the finish again. SUGAR PIE HONEY (11) was a beaten favourite when 3m off SMIRKIN SERENE last week but that was her first outing for more than three months and it should have improved her. A wide draw hurts but she won a final of this series at two so has talent and strikes at 50 per cent second up. OUR SPECIAL MEMORY (3) was just behind SMIRKIN SERENE last week and draws to be competitive.
